pictures.name: MZ1-Artaban-Pearl
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, main subject in the middle of the frame, no text or letters, no logos. King Artaban, a Parthian king in his fifties with a curled dark beard, a tall jeweled cap and deep crimson-and-gold robes, seated in a palace hall of carved cedar and blue tiles, holds up a single large glowing pearl between two fingers, studying it with pride. Lamplight catches the pearl so it shines like a small moon. Rich carpets, deep blue shadows.

pictures.name: MZ2-The-Gift-Arrives
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, main subject in the middle of the frame, no text or letters, no logos. Rabbi Yehuda, an elderly Jewish sage with a long white beard, a cream linen robe and a simple dark blue head covering, in a simple stone study house in Galilee lined with scroll shelves, receives a small open carved box from a kneeling royal messenger in crimson. Inside the box the large pearl glows. The rabbi’s face is calm, kind and thoughtful. Warm oil-lamp light.

pictures.name: MZ3-The-Mezuzah
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, main subject in the middle of the frame, no text or letters, no logos. Close view of Rabbi Yehuda, an elderly Jewish sage with a long white beard, a cream linen robe and a simple dark blue head covering at a wooden table, his weathered hands carefully rolling a tiny parchment scroll and slipping it into a slim plain wooden case. A quill and an inkpot rest nearby. The writing on the parchment is not readable. Golden lamplight, quiet devotion.

pictures.name: MZ4-King-Frowns
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, main subject in the middle of the frame, no text or letters, no logos. King Artaban, a Parthian king in his fifties with a curled dark beard, a tall jeweled cap and deep crimson-and-gold robes, back in his palace hall, holds the slim plain wooden case in his palm and frowns, puzzled and offended, while a messenger bows. On a cushion beside him, an empty jeweled box. Contrast of royal splendor and the small humble case.

pictures.name: MZ5-Guards-At-Night
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, main subject in the middle of the frame, no text or letters, no logos. Night in an ancient stone house: moonlight falls on the doorway, where a slim case is fixed at a slant on the right doorpost. Inside, beyond the open door, a family sleeps peacefully on woven mats under warm blankets, a small oil lamp glowing low. Deep blue night, a feeling of being watched over.

pictures.name: MZ6-Today-Doorframe
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, main subject in the middle of the frame, no text or letters, no logos. Today: the front door of a modern city apartment, painted in the same oil style. A young woman in a coat, keys in one hand, rests the fingertips of her other hand on a slanted mezuzah case on the right doorpost as she steps out into morning light. Warm, ordinary, tender.
